item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 24 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 24 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 19 August 2026(Wednesday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac(San Clemente, Camiling, Santa Ignacia, Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas, Bamban), Pampanga(Mabalacat, Angeles, Porac, San Fernando, Bacolor, Santa Rita, Guagua, Lubao, Floridablanca, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol, Minalin, Santo Tomas, Apalit), Bulacan(Calumpit, Hagonoy, Paombong, Baliuag, Bustos, Pandi, Marilao, Meycauayan, Bocaue, Balagtas, Santa Maria, Bulakan, Guiguinto, Malolos, Plaridel, Pulilan, Obando), Metro Manila(Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Navotas, Las Pinas, Paranaque, Pasay, Manila), Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon, Magallanes, Naic, Tanza, Rosario, Noveleta, Cavite City, Kawit, Imus, Bacoor, General Trias) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Tuy, Balayan, Calatagan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Rizal, Nueva Ecija, Metro Manila(Quezon City, Muntinlupa, Taguig, Makati, Mandaluyong, Pasig, San Juan, Pateros, Marikina), Cavite(Alfonso, Amadeo, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Indang, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Trece Martires, Carmona, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez), Batangas(Agoncillo, Tanauan, Talisay, Lemery, Calaca, Laurel), Laguna(Calamba, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, Magalang, Mexico, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana) and Bulacan(Angat, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Quezon(Panukulan, Polillo), Batangas(San Nicolas, Taal, Santa Teresita, San Luis, Bauan, Mabini, San Pascual, Alitagtag, Cuenca, San Jose, Lipa, Mataasnakahoy, Balete, Malvar, Santo Tomas, Batangas City, Ibaan, Tingloy) and Laguna(Alaminos, Calauan, Bay, Los Banos, Santa Maria, Mabitac, Pangil, Pakil, Siniloan, Famy, Victoria) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
